headword: {一切合切|いっさいがっさい}

definitions.gloss: absolutely everything; the whole lot; lock, stock, and barrel
definitions.explanation: An emphatic expression meaning everything without exception. Stronger and more emphatic than {全部|ぜんぶ} or {一切|いっさい} alone.

examples.japanese: {一切合切|いっさいがっさい}⟦{捨|す}てて→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧しまった。
{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一切合切|いっさいがっさい}⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I disposed of the whole lot when I moved.

examples.japanese: ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一切合切|いっさいがっさい}⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}めたい。
examples.english: I want to forget absolutely everything about the past and start a new life.

notes:
A rhyming emphatic doubling of ⟦{一切|いっさい}→一切：06662_issai⟧ (everything, all). The addition of ⟦{合切|がっさい}→合切：24150_gassai⟧ intensifies the meaning, emphasizing completeness — nothing is excluded. The rhythmic quality gives it a decisive, forceful tone.

USAGE:
Used when emphasizing that something applies to every single thing without exception. Often appears with verbs of disposal, forgetting, or giving up. More dramatic and emphatic than ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧ or ⟦{一切|いっさい}→一切：06662_issai⟧ alone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一切合切|いっさいがっさい}⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧ — to throw away everything
- {一切合切|いっさいがっさい}⟦{任|まか}せる→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧ — to entrust everything
- {一切合切|いっさいがっさい}⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧ — to take absolutely everything

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一切|いっさい}→一切：06662_issai⟧ — all, everything; less emphatic, also used with negatives (⟦{一切|いっさい}→一切：06662_issai⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧)
- ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧ — all, everything; neutral and everyday
- {根|ね}こそぎ — completely, from the roots; implies thorough removal
